items.stem: In the Gemini + Sheets + Looker Studio workflow, what is the correct handling of an insight Gemini generates?

options.text: Verify the insight against the underlying data before relying on it
options.rationale: Correct: AI-generated insights must be checked against the source numbers.
Unverified AI output can be wrong and misleading.

options.text: Assume it is correct because it sounds confident
options.rationale: Confidence is not accuracy; verification is required.

options.text: Delete the source data once Gemini has summarized it
options.rationale: The source data is needed for verification and refresh.

items.explanation: Correct: AI-generated insights must be checked against the source numbers.

items.stem: Which TWO steps make the analytics pipeline more reliable? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Clean and structure the data in Sheets before building the dashboard
options.rationale: Correct: clean input prevents misleading dashboards.

options.text: Configure the Looker Studio data source to refresh so figures stay current
options.rationale: Correct: refresh keeps the dashboard current.

options.text: Build the dashboard directly on an unclean export
Share the dashboard publicly to simplify access
options.rationale: Public sharing can expose sensitive figures.

items.explanation: Correct: clean data and configured refresh improve reliability.

items.stem: You need to show how monthly revenue has changed over the past year. Which chart type is most appropriate?

options.rationale: Correct: a line chart shows change over time clearly.
A pie chart shows composition at one point, not a trend.
A scorecard shows one value, not the trend.
Raw rows do not make the trend visible at a glance.

items.explanation: Correct: a line chart shows change over time clearly.
